summary: Avoid claim-history enumeration in runtime roster reads

replay.detail: Existing claims and projections are read unchanged. No replay is required.

rules.detail: Runtime resources retain canonical status authority but do not compute unused claim vectors or session summaries. Full, summary, runtime and agent-card reductions have independent cache entries. Status reduction modes appear as named SQL profile phases.

compatibility.detail: Public status vectors, runtime resources, pinned snapshots and cancellation semantics are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Older binaries can read the unchanged claims.
